reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: liquidate_as_coin is declared `public fun` (public API exception applies) and has one non-test internal caller at liquidate.move:147. Gate 2: BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json has no trust_assumptions section; cannot trigger. Gate 3: contracts/protocol/sources/entry_points/lending/liquidate.move is explicitly in-scope and liquidation logic is a listed focus area. An attacker can trigger this via the liquidate_as_coin entry point (through any whitelisted interface package holding a PackageCallerCap) by passing their own obligation_id, causing them to receive seized collateral worth D*(1+incentive)*(1-fee) while repaying only D in debt tokens, capturing the liquidation bonus that should incentivize third-party liquidators and extracting value from the protocol. Severity set to High: direct financial exploit against liquidation integrity (a focus area), unlimited repetition by any underwater borrower, no on-chain cap.
